name: lorikeet-roi
description: Estimates what AI customer support would cost and save at your ticket volume, and compares building it in house with buying it.

interface.longDescription: Estimate what AI customer support would cost and save at your ticket volume. One calculator compares an AI vendor that charges for every ticket it attempts with one that charges only for tickets it resolves, including the effect on CSAT. The other compares the 3 year cost and time to go live of building AI support in house against buying it. Same maths as the CX ROI Calculator and Build vs Buy Calculator on lorikeet.tools. What you enter is not saved.
capabilities: Compare AI pricing per ticket with pricing per resolution at your volume, and the effect on CSAT.
Compare the 3 year cost and time to go live of building AI support in house against buying it.
defaultPrompt: We get 25,000 support tickets a month and AI could resolve about 60%. What would AI support cost and save?
Compare paying per ticket with paying per resolution for AI support at 10,000 tickets a month.
Should we build our own AI support agent or buy one? 4 engineers at $180k and 40,000 tickets a month.
